entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A warrior who uses his sword and personal connection to lightning to resurrect Weston.
entities.quote: Zayn draws his sword, slams its tip into the earth, and roars. A pillar of lightning tears through the sky, finds the blade, and launches through him like a conduit straight into Weston’s chest

entities.name: Grace
entities.description: An individual possessing cosmic light powers that fail against dark energy.
entities.quote: Grace kneels beside them, cosmic light flickering in her palms, but every spark she calls dies the instant it touches the black wound.

timeline_events.title: Resurrection of Weston
timeline_events.description: Zayn performs a ritual using his sword and a lightning strike to bring Weston back to life.
timeline_events.quote: Zayn draws his sword, slams its tip into the earth, and roars. A pillar of lightning tears through the sky, finds the blade, and launches through him like a conduit straight into Weston’s chest
